niche: an academic medical center's first coverage statement for its conflict-of-interest registry: what clinical faculty received from companies in the year against what their disclosures show, manufacturers checked payment by payment against the federal Open Payments register, companies outside the register estimated from the tax forms faculty attached, with the completeness of those attachments measured where the register can see it and the speaker-program fees that agencies pay on manufacturers' behalf traced back to the manufacturers
answer: to be filled from generator/figures.json when the pack is cut
analyst_test: A strong analyst who links the three sources, reads every field and clause correctly, sets aside the forms the policy excludes and checks the attached forms of those who uploaded against the register grosses the outside-company forms up by the uploaders' own completeness: the faculty who confirmed that no form was received or never answered, though the register shows payments that must have produced one, stay out of the rate; the forms companies they left off the disclosure are attached far less often than the forms of companies they named; and the fees a speaker agency paid for a manufacturer read as manufacturer forms that were never attached. The estimate of remuneration from companies outside the register that the disclosures do not show lands well under or over the golden range, and the departments' figures with it.
domain_test: Every result is a quantity a statistical office produces when it measures the coverage of a register: a list linked to an administrative register and to a second list, the share of known units the second list captured by what the first list said about them, an estimate of the units and the amounts neither list holds for the part of the population the administrative register cannot see, its range from resampling the people, and a check of the transport on the units both lists can be compared on. Swap the faculty for stores and the tax forms for delivery notes and there is no register that sees one class of payer and not the other, no confirmation of nothing received that the register can contradict, and no agent paying on a principal's behalf: nothing is left to estimate.

driver: A total is wanted for the part of a population that no outside record covers, and the only evidence is a second list its members supplied voluntarily; the share of that list that was supplied is measured on the part of the population an outside record does cover, over every member and not only those who supplied something, separately for the items each member had and had not already declared, after the outside record's items paid through an intermediary are traced to the intermediary's entry on the list; the supplied items for the uncovered part are then raised by those shares, and the result is checked where declared items can be compared across the two parts.
driver_concrete: Remuneration clinical faculty received in 2025 from companies outside Open Payments is seen only through the Forms 1099 they uploaded with the disclosure. How completely forms were uploaded is measured on the manufacturer side, where Open Payments shows which forms must exist: over every faculty member with such a form (those who confirmed that none was received and those who never answered included), separately for companies the disclosure named and left off, and with the speaker-program fees an agency paid on a manufacturer's behalf matched to the agency's form. The uploaded forms of outside companies the disclosure left off are raised by the left-off rate, the named ones are carried from the disclosures at the amount ratio the uploaded pairs show, and the estimate is stated with the range from resampling faculty and checked on named relationships, where manufacturers' and other companies' forms were uploaded at the same rate.
stump: The careful pass grosses the uploaded outside forms up by the completeness of the faculty who uploaded something, taking a confirmation that no form was received at its word, pools named and left-off companies in one rate, and counts a manufacturer whose fees an agency paid as a form never uploaded; each of the three moves the estimate of remuneration not shown by a different amount in a different direction, and a run that corrects one still files a figure outside the range.

differentiation.task5: task5 completes an administrative census caught early, report by report, by the cause of each outstanding report; here nothing is early or late: a closed year's voluntary document list is weighted by how completely it was supplied, measured against a register that covers one class of payer, and the two builds share no result.
differentiation.task6: task6 recovers an inclusion probability each sampled trace inherits from its edge request; here the capture share is a behaviour of people measured against an outside register and carried to payers the register never sees, with an intermediary's payments reconciled first.
differentiation.mark126: Mark's 126 splits units a succession link had joined, on a classification kept in a second ledger, to date a duration; here no unit is joined or split: the share of a voluntary list that was supplied is estimated against a register that covers one class of payer and carried to the class it cannot see, and the answer is an estimated total with a range, not a corrected median.

lineage.architecture: v1 (first decisive step, replaced at stage 4 before ship)
lineage.fate: landed: the stage-4 leak reader, reading blind, filed the golden docket with a matched-line ratio shrunk by dollars; judge stump power moderate
lineage.driver: Each unit's amount in the latest period is seen only through its own report, which leaves some items out entirely and understates the amounts of those it keeps, each unit at its own rate; the correction for a kept item's amount is the unit's understatement measured on the items its report kept in the closed periods, not its overall share reported (which carries the items it left out), and that measure is noise on a short record, so it is weighted toward the common rate by the number of items the record holds; the grain alone or the weighting alone each reproduce the last closed period worse than no correction.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst measures each faculty member's completeness as the share of their 2021 to 2025 register remuneration they disclosed, back-tests it on 2025 against the faculty-wide ratio and the disclosures at face value, finds face value closest and sends five faithful disclosers in place of five long-record under-reporters; each person's matched-line ratio unweighted sends thin-record faculty instead, and the overall share weighted by the record sends the faculty who leave small relationships out.

lineage.architecture: v1 (shipped under the retired single-deep-step design; uploaded 2026-11-10)
lineage.fate: returned by the platform on 2026-11-10 before any run: the domain fit read the docket of fifteen under a stated threshold, the count of filers and the two tabulations as compliance lookups with no estimation, and the prompt test read the slices as method spelled out (runs/review_2026-11-10.md)
lineage.driver: Each unit's amount in the latest period is seen only through its own report, which covers only what had happened by the day the report was made, while the closed periods' records date every event in the full period; the unit's reporting error must be measured with each earlier report compared against the events up to its own date, and the latest report grossed up for the part of the period it could not yet see, so units that reported early look like under-reporters and units that reported early this time look small to the natural full-period comparison.
lineage.stump: A strong analyst builds each faculty member's matched-line ratio weighted toward the faculty's, compares every disclosure with the register's whole program year, finds it closest to 2025 among the whole-year corrections and sends five faculty whose earlier December disclosures made them look like under-reporters in place of five who submitted their 2026 disclosures in early December, before their retainers' December installments.

The decisive generator was redrawn from G12 to G3, record against operation, after the guard matched G12 with task6's second architecture and Mark's 196: the uploaded forms and the confirmations are the record, the forms companies issued are the operation, and every result measures the distance between them; G12 (a confirmation of nothing received is not evidence of nothing) and G5 (an agency's form provides for the manufacturer's fees) stay as the supporting generators.
